title: Presidents not told unless, like Bush 41, they were CIA director

tellings.quote: So unless you're George H.W. Bush, Bush 41, who is director of the CIA as the president of the United States, you probably don't even know

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who has gone public with claims about hidden UFO programmes, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that American presidents are probably not told about these secrets. He says the exception would be someone like George H.W. Bush, the 41st president, who had earlier been director of the CIA, the country's foreign intelligence agency. If true, it would mean the secret is kept even from the elected head of government.
